objective: Physically inspect the production Lab source-health fault bar without modifying persisted MCP activity state or causing a real source outage.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.one_controller_rule: persistent product supervisor must be stopped for this one-shot sequence and restarted immediately afterward

operation.shape: one connection; three frozen frames healthy -> simulated Lab unavailable -> healthy; one ACK per frame; close
operation.semantic_evidence: Frames are generated by host.activity_render.render_rgb888 from a copy of current normalized activity state. Only copied optiplex_lab.source_health/error_code differ in the middle frame; no collector, source config, persisted state, or product runtime source is modified.

render_assertions.expected_pixel_delta: only production FAULT_MARKER in Lab crown row: x=1..3, y=0, RGB=(170,0,0)

budgets.derivation: 3 seconds healthy, 3 seconds fault, then healthy final frame; stock-derived image sequence route, default 40 ms intra-frame packet spacing.

expected_observations.transport: one connection, nine application packets, three wrapped 0x44 ACKs, clean local close
expected_observations.physical: Lab starts grey with no top marker; after about 3 s a dim-red 3-pixel bar appears across the Lab crown top row while Lab remains grey; after about 3 s the bar disappears.
expected_observations.interpretation: This proves production fault-bar rendering on the panel, not genuine source-outage detection.

persistence_analysis.source_state_effect: none; all health mutation exists only in copied render state used to generate frozen PNGs
persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; product runtime source/hash is untouched

stop_immediately_on: unexpected target identity or pairing precheck failure
any send that does not complete in full
unexpected inbound report/stock takeover during sequence
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop, preserve diagnostics, do not rerun 009; any retry requires a fresh experiment id and grant
stop_policy.recovery: restart the already-authorized persistent product service after the one-shot sequence returns

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE execution only of OPENDITOO-M9-ACTIVATION-009: stop the persistent product supervisor, run the exact frozen 3-frame Lab fault-bar sequence (healthy -> simulated unavailable -> healthy) on exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7, then restart the persistent product supervisor; one connection, 3 frames, 9 packets, 494 application bytes, 3000 ms inter-frame delay, no retry/reconnect/raw send/target override/source-state mutation.

explicitly_out_of_scope: any target other than exact unit
